    def test_negative_update(sheet_name, test_name, prompt, section_name, entry_name, evaluation_metrice, evaluation_model, client, ragmetric, generate, view_helpers_factory):
        """
        Test negative update queries for 2 randomly picked rows from the Excel sheet per sheet.
        Generates an invalid update command and expects the LLM to respond with an error or correction.
        """
        import io, sys, datetime
        import uuid
        allure.dynamic.parent_suite(sheet_name)
        allure.dynamic.suite("negative_update")
        allure.dynamic.sub_suite(test_name)
        exec_time = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
        allure.attach(exec_time, name="Execution Time", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
        stdout_capture = io.StringIO()
        old_stdout = sys.stdout
        sys.stdout = stdout_capture
        try:
            # Load section and item descriptions from Excel
            try:
                sections_data = load_sections()
            except Exception:
                sections_data = []
            section_desc = None
            for s in sections_data:
                if s.get('SECTION_NAME') == section_name:
                    section_desc = s.get('SECTION_DESC')
                    break
    
            try:
                entries_data = load_entries()
            except Exception:
                entries_data = []
            item_desc = None
            for e in entries_data:
                if e.get('ENTRY_NAME') == entry_name:
                    item_desc = e.get('ITEM_DESC')
                    break
    
            # Use a fresh chat_id for each test
            chat_id = client.create_chat()
            allure.attach(chat_id, name="Chat ID", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
    
            # Generate a negative (invalid) update query
            invalid_update_query = generate.negative_update_query(section_name=section_name, entry_name=entry_name, section_desc=section_desc or "", item_desc=item_desc or "")
            allure.attach(str(invalid_update_query), name="Negative Update Query", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
    
            # Generate the expected response for the invalid query
            expected_response = generate.expected_negative_response(section_name=section_name, entry_name=entry_name, invalid_query=invalid_update_query, section_desc=section_desc or "", item_desc=item_desc or "")
            allure.attach(str(expected_response), name="Expected Response", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            Original_value = client.get_config_entry_with_mapped_section(section_name, entry_name, generate_llm=generate)
            allure.attach(str(Original_value), name="Original Config Value", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            # Send the invalid update query to the LLM
            ask_result = client.ask(chat_id=chat_id, user_query=invalid_update_query)
            text_response = ask_result["text_response"]
            metadata = ask_result.get("metadata")
            latency = ask_result.get("latency")
    
    
            # Attach metadata
            allure.attach(str(metadata), name="Metadata", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            # Metadata-based conditional handling
            if metadata and metadata.get("type") in ("confirm", "select"):
                helpers = view_helpers_factory(chat_id, section_name, entry_name, section_desc or "", item_desc or "")
                # Handle up to 3 turns, validate metadata and restore if success appears
                helpers.handle_negative_update_conversational_flow(
                    first_response=text_response,
                    prompt_used=invalid_update_query,
                    original_value=Original_value,
                    expected_response=expected_response,
                    index=0,
                    max_turns=3,
                    user_type="Admin"
                )
    
    
    
            else:
                allure.attach(str(latency), name="Latency", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(str(text_response), name="LLM Response", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                # Validate metadata and restore DB if an unintended success occurred
                helpers = view_helpers_factory(chat_id, section_name, entry_name, section_desc or "", item_desc or "")
                if metadata:
                    # Validate section/entry names against sheet values
                    helpers.validate_metadata_match(metadata)
                    # If agent reported a success in a negative update flow, restore using metadata.old
                    if metadata.get("type") == "success":
                        helpers.validate_metadata_and_restore_db(metadata, user_type="Admin")
                updated_value = client.get_config_entry_with_mapped_section(section_name, entry_name, generate_llm=generate)
                if updated_value != Original_value:
                    allure.attach(str(updated_value), name="Updated Config Value", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                    restore_success = client.update_config_entry_value(Original_value)
                    allure.attach(str(restore_success), name="Restored DB value to original (Negative Update)", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                assert updated_value == Original_value, (
                    f"DB value was incorrectly updated after negative update query.\nPrompt: {invalid_update_query}\nDB Value: {updated_value}")
                metric = ragmetric("answer_correctness")
                test_case = LLMTestCase(
                    input=invalid_update_query,
                    actual_output=text_response,
                    expected_output=expected_response
                )
                metric.measure(test_case)
                allure.attach(str(metric.score), name="Score", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(str(metric.reason), name="Reason", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
